about: Misthalin piece 7 step 6b: Tolna's rift dungeon after A Soul's Bane (TolnasRift.kt). The four rooms' monsters round the lobby: angry bears, unicorns, giant rats and goblins in the Anger room (north-west), fear reapers in the Fear room (north-east), confusion beasts in the Confusion room (south-east) and hopeless creatures in the Hopeless room (south-west), on the tiles mejrs's list saw them, moved with the dungeon to its place in the 241 cache.
